rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only learned speed intervention must maintain valid completion and improve lap time against the selected pixel controller.
observable_information: Rendered pixels and inherited pixel-driver action at inference; matched local TRAIN completion, lap, collision and latency telemetry for evaluation.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Veto boost when inherited gas is below 0.08, else add no more than 0.04 gas capped at 0.28; retain confident coast and inherited steering/braking.
expected_success_endpoint: At least selected valid completion, zero invalid actions, 100 bounded boosts, 20 vetoes and, on a completion tie, at least 2% median finished-lap improvement overall and jointly finished.
control: Unchanged selected stable-risk pixel driver on the same twelve newly assigned TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Lower valid completion, invalid action, inactive mechanism or insufficient median lap improvement on a completion tie.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two frozen pixel-only arms on tracks 1-3 x unused TRAIN seeds 5024-5027, 24 registered episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no TUNE, held-out, confirmation, blind, official or external action.
